why: Image 2 tries to look lived-in with long-exposure people, but they are uniform grey, faceless and untextured, like clay mannequins, so they give the picture away as CG faster than anything else in either frame. Image 1 is cleaner and emptier, but its warm pools of light, crisp table-lamp shadows on the floor, and believable wood and concrete hold together as one night interior an interiors photographer could have shot.
